scenes.caption: Morning.
scenes.say: Sam walks to school. A crossing patrol person helps him.

scenes.caption: The baker.
scenes.say: He passes the baker, who gets up early.

scenes.caption: A new child.
scenes.say: At school, a new classmate looks shy.

scenes.caption: Hello.
scenes.say: Sam says hello and asks her name.

scenes.caption: Include.
scenes.say: He invites her to sit and play.

scenes.caption: The cook.
scenes.say: The cook makes lunch for everyone.

scenes.caption: A card.
scenes.say: Sam makes a thank-you card for the cook.

scenes.caption: Together.
scenes.say: Everyone helps. That is what a community is.
